Yalcin Kayan left the pitch to a standing ovation in the 87th minute, replaced by Yunus Emre Cift , while the visitors' late efforts were comfortably absorbed by the host's backline. matches.description: Watch SC Braga vs Estoril Praia highlights and goals from Primeira Liga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 3, 2026. The Primeira Liga spotlight turned to a high-stakes encounter on May 3, 2026, as SC Braga hosted Estoril Praia in a match defined by tactical discipline and sudden bursts of clinical finishing. Both sides entered the pitch looking to assert their dominance in the middle of the park, creating an atmospheric contest where every inch of turf was fiercely contested. Dorgeles Breaks the Deadlock The match began with SC Braga looking to dictate the tempo through sustained possession and clever wing play. Their persistence paid off in the 23rd minute when a sequence of intricate passing carved open the visitors' defense. Leonardo Lelo provided the spark with a pinpoint key pass that found Rodrigo Zalazar , who in turn set up Mario Dorgeles . With a composed right-footed strike, Dorgeles found the back of the net to give the home side the lead. This opening goal shifted the momentum, forcing Estoril Praia to abandon their conservative shape and push higher up the pitch. As the first half progressed, the physical nature of the football on display became evident as the referee was forced to reach for his pocket multiple times. Gabriel Moscardo and Demir Tiknaz both saw yellow cards for heavy challenges, while Estoril ’s Xeka was booked for a dangerous tackle. Despite the rising tension and several set-piece opportunities, including a Rodrigo Zalazar free kick that whistled wide, Braga headed into the tunnel with their slim advantage intact. Tactical Shifts and VAR Drama The second half saw both managers turn to their benches to find a fresh spark. Braga introduced Luisinho for Zalazar , while Estoril brought on Andre Lacximicant to bolster their attacking options. The game nearly took a decisive turn in the 58th minute when the referee paused play for a lengthy VAR review regarding a potential penalty for Estoril . While the visitors grew in confidence following the review, they struggled initially to find the final ball, with Yanis Begraoui and Lacximicant both caught in the offside trap during promising breaks. As the clock ticked toward the final ten minutes, the pressure from the away side finally told. In the 79th minute, a rare defensive lapse from Carvalho allowed Ricard Sanchez to seize the ball and fire a cross into the path of Yanis Begraoui . The striker made no mistake, hitting a precise right-footed shot past the keeper to level the match . The goal silenced the home crowd and set the stage for a frantic finale where both teams had a chance to snatch all three points. A Frantic Finish in Braga The closing stages were a whirlwind of activity as SC Braga threw everything forward in search of a winner. Gabriel Moscardo thought he had secured the victory in the 87th minute with a powerful header, but Martin Turk produced a stunning save to keep the scores level. Minutes later, Carvalho saw his own headed effort blocked by a resilient Estoril backline. The tension boiled over in stoppage time as Luisinho received a yellow card for a reckless challenge on Antef Tsoungui , and Lukas Hornicek was forced into a late claim to deny a shot from Alejandro Marques . Ultimately, neither side could find the decisive blow before the final whistle. The sports drama concluded with the points shared, leaving Braga to rue their missed opportunities while Estoril celebrated a hard-earned result on the road. The result reflects a balanced battle where both tactical execution and individual moments of brilliance took center stage.

matches.description: Watch SC Braga vs Estrela highlights and goals from Primeira Liga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 16, 2026. The Estádio Municipal de Braga set the stage for a high-stakes encounter between SC Braga and Estrela da Amadora on May 16, 2026. In a match defined by VAR interventions and relentless drama, both sides fought until the very last second in this Primeira Liga clash. Early Fireworks and VAR Intervention The contest ignited early as the visitors stunned the home crowd in the 5th minute. Stefan Lekovic reacted quickest to a loose ball in the penalty area, firing home with his right foot to give Estrela da Amadora the lead. A lengthy VAR check followed, but the goal stood. SC Braga did not stay down for long, responding in the 15th minute. After a short corner sequence involving João Moutinho , Gabri Martínez rose at the near post to head the ball home from close range. Once again, the VAR was called into action, eventually confirming the equalizer and restoring parity. Tactical Dominance and Defensive Grit For much of the game, SC Braga controlled the tempo, maintaining a staggering 74% of ball possession. The home side peppered the opposition half with attacks, while Estrela da Amadora relied on a resolute defensive block. João Moutinho was instrumental in midfield but earned a yellow card in the 37th minute for a tactical foul to stop a counter-attack. As the second half progressed, the match grew more physical. Renan Ribeiro and Luan Patrick both entered the referee's book as the visitors fought to withstand the mounting pressure from the Braga front line. Stoppage Time Chaos and Lekovic’s Redemption The match reached a fever pitch in the closing stages. In the 87th minute, a VAR review resulted in a penalty for SC Braga after Luan Patrick tripped Leonardo Lelo . Pau Víctor stepped up in the 90th minute and coolly dispatched the spot-kick into the center of the net to make it 2-1. However, the drama was far from over. In the 6th minute of added time, Jovane Cabral provided a pinpoint assist for Stefan Lekovic , who struck a dramatic late equalizer. The Serbian's joy turned to despair moments later, as his excessive celebrations earned him a second yellow card and a subsequent red, leaving his team to see out the final seconds with ten men in a pulsating draw.
